tools.name: xrpl_fee
tools.description: Current XRPL fee tiers in drops with a congestion score. When to use: Before submitting a transaction, to choose a `Fee` and to decide whether the network is congested. Prefer another tool: Not a price feed and not a historical series; it describes the latest validated ledger only. Example: xrpl_fee

tools.name: xrpl_network_health
tools.description: Overall and per-node health of the upstream XRPL nodes. When to use: To decide whether to trust or retry data, or to explain a 503 from another endpoint. Prefer another tool: Not a probe of your own connectivity; it reports the service's upstream nodes. Example: xrpl_network_health {}

tools.name: xrpl_orderbook
tools.description: CLOB order book for a currency pair with unfunded offers removed. When to use: To read executable liquidity for a pair on the XRPL central limit order book (CLOB). Prefer another tool: Not for AMM liquidity (use the amm page) and not for a cost estimate (use the slippage page). Example: xrpl_orderbo

tools.name: xrpl_slippage
tools.description: Slippage and average price for buying an amount of base currency. When to use: Before placing a market-style trade, to size it against available depth and to see whether the CLOB or the AMM pool is the cheaper venue. Prefer another tool: It is an estimate, not a quote, and it does not split an amoun

tools.name: xrpl_amm
tools.description: AMM pool reserves and trading fee for an asset pair. When to use: To read AMM pool depth and fee for a pair. Prefer another tool: It does not estimate slippage or compare venues (use the slippage page for the CLOB vs AMM comparison); a pair without a pool returns 404. Example: xrpl_amm {"a":"XRP","b

tools.name: xrpl_account_summary
tools.description: XRP balance, sequence, owner count, transfer rate and trust lines (capped) for an account. When to use: To inspect an account before building a transaction for it. Prefer another tool: Not for transaction history, reserves or account flags; it is a summary, not a full account dump. Example: xrpl_acc

tools.name: xrpl_account_lines
tools.description: One page of an account's trust lines, with an opaque cursor for the next page. When to use: To list every trust line of an account (balances, limits, freeze and authorization flags), page by page. Prefer another tool: For a quick capped overview with the XRP balance, use `/v1/xrpl/account/{address}/

tools.name: xrpl_account_transactions
tools.description: One page of an account's most recent validated transactions, newest first. When to use: To check what an account did recently (payments sent or received, offers, trust line changes) and whether each transaction succeeded. tools.name: xrpl_token
tools.description: Issuer data for an issued asset: flags, domain, transfer fee and total issued. tools.name: xrpl_payment_readiness
tools.description: Pre-payment check: can this payment from source to destination succeed now? When to use: Right before sending a payment: to catch a missing or unfunded destination, a required destination tag, deposit authorization, missing or frozen trust lines, insufficient balance and issuer freezes, in one call.

tools.name: xrpl_paths
tools.description: Multi-hop payment paths and their source cost. When to use: Before a cross-currency or multi-hop payment: to see whether a route exists and how much the source would spend to deliver the amount. A call can take up to about 20 seconds and paths may be non-optimal. Prefer another tool: To check whethe

tools.name: xrpl_latest_ledger
tools.description: Latest validated ledger index, hash and close time. When to use: To anchor other readings to a ledger or to check how current the network view is. Prefer another tool: Not for transaction data or account state; use the account endpoint for those. Example: xrpl_latest_ledger {}

tools.name: solana_transfer_readiness
tools.description: Will this Solana transfer succeed? A verdict for SOL or an SPL or Token-2022 token. When to use: Before building or signing a Solana transfer, to learn whether it will fail and what it will cost in rent and fees. tools.name: solana_token
tools.description: Is this Solana token safe to hold or receive? A SAFE, WARN or DANGER verdict. When to use: Before accepting or swapping into an unfamiliar token, to see whether its mint can freeze, mint more, move or tax balances. tools.name: solana_latest_slot
tools.description: Latest finalized Solana slot and its block time. When to use: To check how fresh the finalized view of Solana is, or to anchor a read to a slot. Prefer another tool: Not a tip-of-chain feed: it is finalized, not processed or confirmed, and it is cached for 2 seconds. Example: solana_latest_slot {}

tools.name: solana_network_health
tools.description: Whether Solana data is currently being served: latest probe status and finalized slot. When to use: Before relying on the Solana verdict endpoints, or to explain a 503 from them. Prefer another tool: Not a measure of the Solana network itself, only of this service's access to it; use the latest-slot
